items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Old Gasper, well I remember him when he was playing with Robey Shows Band Bass, orchestra... I saw him play about four or five jobs.

ctx.x: Oh yeah? Controlled the good musicians. That's why I can understand how his boy become a tenor saxophone. I thought he would think I'd say he's five years old. He plays clarinet some. Clarinet some. And he's a tenor sax. Very good tenor sax. And he had, let's see this, he had old man Gasper, old Gasper playing bass.
What about, can you tell a bit more about old Gasper?

Old Gasper, well I remember him when he was playing with Robey Shows Band Bass, orchestra, not the band. Played bass violin, strictly a bass violin man, and a good bass violin. And uh, did you know that going at Machine Bill? No, I remember. He played, I saw him play about four or five jobs. Once with many, twice with many careers. And he also played with George Moray, bass violin. He had a little concert. I think it was on Tulane Avenue.
